Wms._comment: Interim toggle (XD01-95) — the in-app Leaflet map loads WMS tiles via plain elements, which can never carry a bearer token, so features:read can't actually be enforced against this app's own map yet. Defaults to false (open) until a real fix is designed; set true to require features:read like every other endpoint (e.g. for external GIS clients such as QGIS, which can attach one).

GeoAssets._providersComment: GeoAssets:Providers (XD01-371): the named asset catalogs this host serves, each built at startup by the provider plugin it names ('postgres' is registered by the postgres-spatial module). 'primary' is the default catalog every request reads. A catalog whose plugin no enabled module registers is skipped with a warning.
GeoAssets._comment: GeoAssets:Modules (XD01-358/XD01-359): the modules this host enables, in order. 'postgres-spatial' = the PostgreSQL/PostGIS asset store, organization catalogs and WMS; 'neutral-operator' = shared-use dispatch, pole occupancy, clandestine attachments, ISP tenant portal and the in-process asset-mutation apply; 'ip-billing-bridge' = the município grant provisioning. A blank entry is ignored, so an environment variable such as GeoAssets__Modules__1= disables the module at that position; blank every entry to boot the kernel only.

Outbox._comment: Workflow integration-event transport (XD01-357): the broker the transactional outbox relay publishes the order workflows' integration events to: 'Kafka' (options in a 'WorkflowKafka' section), 'ServiceBus' (options in 'WorkflowServiceBus') or 'None'. With 'None' staged events stay pending in the outbox table until the host runs with a transport, except asset mutation batches, which this host applies to its own catalog (GeoAssets:Catalog:InstanceId) in process.
